mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 END) as "inProgress", COUNT(CASE WHEN t.due_on = CURRENT_DATE AND t.status != 'DONE' THEN 1 END) as "dueToday", COUNT(CASE WHEN t.due_on < CURRENT_DATE AND t.status != 'DONE' THEN 1 END) as "overdue" FROM project_task t INNER JOIN project p ON t.project_id = p.id WHERE t.assignee_no = #{empNo} AND p.status NOT IN ('ON_HOLD', 'DONE', 'CANCELED')

SELECT t.id, t.project_id as projectId, p.name as projectName, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.progress_rate as progressRate, t.due_on as dueOn, t.priority, e.name as assigneeName, e.department as departmentName FROM project_task t LEFT JOIN project p ON t.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN employee e ON t.assignee_no = e.employee_no WHERE t.assignee_no = #{empNo} AND t.status != 'DONE' AND p.status NOT IN ('ON_HOLD', 'DONE', 'CANCELED') ORDER BY t.due_on ASC
